$comment: Model IDs, effort levels, token prices, plan limits and pricing. Code reads these through @sb/config; never hard-code them.

spendReservation.$comment: Every paid call reserves its estimated cost under the daily cap before it is sent (atomically, so parallel calls can't both take the last room) and books its real cost after. Model calls: input from the request's text at charsPerToken (Slovene and JSON run below 3) plus tokensPerImage per image (the API's ~1.15-megapixel resize, about 1,600 tokens), output at the stage's maxTokens, all at uncached prices: an upper bound for the output, an estimate for the input. Generated pictures reserve their configured price.

formEmail.$comment: Contact-form email to the site's owner account (Resend; nothing when the site has no owner account). The message is stored first; the submit waits at most waitMs for the send, then answers the visitor the same either way. A failed or slow send stays pending and the web process retries it every retryEveryMinutes, at most maxAttempts sends in all, for messages received within retryWithinHours (under Resend's 24 h idempotency window); then it is marked failed and the owner's message list says the email didn't go out. Resend's idempotency key (form message id) keeps a retry from sending twice within 24 h. Visitor limits: limits.formMessages*.

composition.$comment: Report-only targets for the generated homepage's first screen (eval), phone 360×800 and desktop 1280×800. Photo share applies only when the client gave photos. They don't fail a checkpoint.

versions.$comment: Spec version retention (owner's decision sb-autosave-versions = prune, 2026-10-01). Every editor autosave stores a full version. A nightly job (cron, read in timeZone) keeps every version from today and the keepAllDays whole days before it, then only the last version of each older day, plus every version that was ever published and the current one. Versions never change; files only pruned versions used are removed with them.

imageGen.$comment: Images from fal.ai: eval fixture photos (pnpm fixtures:ai-photos) and, for client sites with fewer than pipeline.fillUpTo photos, up to that many generated mood images, labelled on the site (owner's decisions 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01). A homepage preview uses 2 (hero + one image-text; keeps it under the €0.30 preview target), a full site 3. Needs FAL_KEY; without it the pipeline skips generation. Prices from fal's pricing API on 2026-09-30; gpt-image-2.5 is token-billed, so its per-megapixel price is fal's 1024x1024 high-quality estimate ($0.05268) scaled by area.

pipeline.style: Realistic photograph, natural available light, true-to-life colours, an ordinary everyday setting in Slovenia. No people's faces, no text, no lettering on signs or packaging, no logos, no shop fronts, no watermark, no borders.

worker.$comment: Shutdown and recovery of the job worker. On SIGTERM it takes no new jobs and lets running ones finish for Railway's draining window (the service variable RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS, Railway's default 0 s) minus drainReserveSeconds, or drainSeconds when that variable isn't set (docker compose stop waits 10 s); jobs still running then are marked interrupted (site 'failed' with a retry, ai_jobs 'interrupted', not counted). A worker killed without that (SIGKILL, crash) stops its jobs' pg-boss heartbeat; after heartbeatSeconds pg-boss fails them and the next recovery pass (at start and every minute) marks them the same way.

accounts.$comment: Owner accounts (sb-signin: email magic link only, no passwords). Session and device cookies are httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure when deployed. Magic links are random, stored hashed, single-use; requests are rate-limited per normalised email and per keyed IP hash (the IP itself is never stored).

tiers.$comment: Free generation limits (docs/plans/free-generation-limits.md; owner's decisions sb-free-tiers = 1-2-10, sb-ai-allowance = first-month, sb-bot-check = Turnstile). Every model and image job is checked before it is queued, against its estimated cost; the real cost comes from the per-call log. anonymous: homepages per device, unclaimed previews deleted after keepDays. free (email account): homepages and chat edits in total, not per month; the anonymous preview carries over without using one. paid (and allow-listed before billing): a monthly € allowance of allowancePercentOfMonthlyPrice % of plans.paid.monthlyEur, plus firstMonthExtraEur in the first month; months run from the day the account got paid rights. perIpGenerationsPerDay: anonymous and free generations per keyed IP hash in 24 h (loose: mobile networks share IPs). pools: each tier's share of limits.dailyModelSpendCapEur per UTC day (admin jobs use the paid pool); a warning at warnAt of a pool. estimatesEur: what a job may cost, held until its calls are logged (measured: homepage with 2 generated pictures €0.26, full site with 3 ~€0.43, chat edit ~€0.012; photo descriptions are one vision call for all of a job's photos: 1 photo €0.002, 3 €0.006, 8 €0.015 in the evals, so altTextPerPhoto €0.005 leaves room for one paid retry). junk: shorter descriptions, or a classifier confidence below the minimum, are refused before any Sonnet or image call.

anonymous.$comment: Uploads without an account: the bot check and the limits run first (a signed one-time ticket, valid ticketMinutes), then at most maxTotalBytes of request body (declared size checked before reading, the stream cut off past it), maxPhotos photos, maxFileBytes per file.

altText.$comment: Photo descriptions (alt job, the vision model) for photos an owner adds in the editor: photos per account in 24 h, on top of the tier's pool (and a paid account's allowance). Adding and replacing photos is never limited; over the cap the owner writes the description. Anonymous visitors can't add photos; the admin has no count.

plans.$comment: Phase 1 has no billing; kept here so later phases read from config.

freePreview.$comment: watermark (owner's decision sb-preview-watermark, 2026-10-02): "app-badge" = a small "Predogled · Stranko" badge in the app beside the preview frame (editor, guest preview, sites list) while the viewer has no paid plan and the site isn't published; never in the site's own HTML, so preview stays equal to published output. "off" = no badge.

paid.$comment: Owner's decision sb-pricing (2026-10-01). Whole euros, VAT included, the same whether or not we're VAT-registered. billingEnabled stays false until the legal entity exists (sb-legal-entity: registered after billing is built, before the first charge); while it's false the landing page calls these planned prices.
